namespace App\Jobs\Notifications;

use App\Models\Core\Professional\Professional;
use App\Services\Notifications\NotificationPublisher;
use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Bus\Dispatchable;
use Illuminate\Queue\InteractsWithQueue;
use Illuminate\Queue\SerializesModels;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

// V2: Fans out brand status change notifications (active/deactivated) to all connected affiliates.
class FanOutBrandStatusNotificationJob implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Dispatchable, InteractsWithQueue, Queueable, SerializesModels;

    public int $tries = 1;

    public function __construct(
        public readonly string $brandProfessionalId,
        public readonly string $brandStatus, // 'active' | 'deactivated'
    ) {
        $this->onQueue('notifications');
    }

    public function handle(NotificationPublisher $publisher): void
    {
        $brand = Professional::find($this->brandProfessionalId);

        if (! $brand) {
            Log::warning('FanOutBrandStatusNotificationJob: brand not found, skipping fan-out', [
                'brand_professional_id' => $this->brandProfessionalId,
            ]);

            return;
        }

        $yearWeek = now()->format('o-W');

        $brandName = (string) ($brand->display_name ?: $brand->handle ?: 'Brand');

        $affiliateIds = DB::table('brand.brand_partner_links')
            ->where('brand_professional_id', $this->brandProfessionalId)
            ->pluck('affiliate_professional_id');

        foreach ($affiliateIds as $affiliateId) {
            try {
                if ($this->brandStatus === 'deactivated') {
                    $publisher->publish(
                        professionalId: $affiliateId,
                        frontendType: 'Warning',
                        category: 'brand_status',
                        title: 'Brand program deactivated',
                        body: "{$brandName}'s affiliate program has been deactivated.",
                        dedupeKey: "brand.deactivated.{$this->brandProfessionalId}.{$yearWeek}",
                        ctaUrl: '/account/store',
                        retentionConfigKey: 'brand_status',
                    );
                } else {
                    $publisher->publish(
                        professionalId: $affiliateId,
                        frontendType: 'Info',
                        category: 'brand_status',
                        title: 'Brand program reactivated',
                        body: "{$brandName}'s affiliate program is now active.",
                        dedupeKey: "brand.reactivated.{$this->brandProfessionalId}.{$yearWeek}",
                        ctaUrl: '/account/store',
                        retentionConfigKey: 'brand_status',
                    );
                }
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                Log::warning('FanOutBrandStatusNotificationJob affiliate notify failed', [
                    'affiliate_id' => $affiliateId,
                    'message' => $e->getMessage(),
                ]);
            }
        }
    }

    public function failed(\Throwable $e): void
    {
        Log::error('Brand status fan-out job failed', [
            'brand_professional_id' => $this->brandProfessionalId,
            'brand_status' => $this->brandStatus,
            'message' => $e->getMessage(),
        ]);
    }
}

// V2: Fans out staff broadcast emails to subscribers in 500-row batches.
class SendStaffBroadcastEmailsJob implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Dispatchable, InteractsWithQueue, Queueable, SerializesModels;

    public function __construct(
        public string $notificationId,
        public string $listKey = 'sidest_updates'
    ) {}

    public function handle(): void

        $notification = Notification::query()->find($this->notificationId);
        if (! $notification) {
            return;

            ->whereNull('professional_id')
            ->where('list_key', $this->listKey)
            ->where('status', 'subscribed')
            ->orderBy('id')
            ->chunkById(500, function ($subs) use ($notification) {
                foreach ($subs as $sub) {
                    SendStaffBroadcastEmailToSubscriberJob::dispatch(
                        $notification->id,
                        $sub->id
                    )->onQueue('mail');
                }
            });
    }
}

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

// V2: Fans out brand status change notifications (active/deactivated) to all connected affiliates.
// Each affiliate gets an independent SendBrandStatusNotificationJob so failures isolate and retry.
class FanOutBrandStatusNotificationJob implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Dispatchable, InteractsWithQueue, Queueable, SerializesModels;

    public int $tries = 3;

    public function __construct(
        public readonly string $brandProfessionalId,
        public readonly string $brandStatus, // 'active' | 'deactivated'
    ) {
        $this->onQueue('notifications');
    }

    public function handle(): void
    {
        $brand = Professional::find($this->brandProfessionalId);

        if (! $brand) {
            Log::warning('FanOutBrandStatusNotificationJob: brand not found, skipping fan-out', [
                'brand_professional_id' => $this->brandProfessionalId,
            ]);

            return;
        }

        $yearWeek = now()->format('o-W');
        $brandName = (string) ($brand->display_name ?: $brand->handle ?: 'Brand');
        $statusSlug = $this->brandStatus === 'deactivated' ? 'deactivated' : 'reactivated';
        $dedupeKey = "brand.{$statusSlug}.{$this->brandProfessionalId}.{$yearWeek}";

        // Dispatch a child job per affiliate so each notification retries independently.
        DB::table('brand.brand_partner_links')
            ->where('brand_professional_id', $this->brandProfessionalId)
            ->orderBy('affiliate_professional_id')
            ->chunkById(500, function ($rows) use ($brandName, $dedupeKey) {
                foreach ($rows as $row) {
                    SendBrandStatusNotificationJob::dispatch(
                        affiliateId: $row->affiliate_professional_id,
                        brandProfessionalId: $this->brandProfessionalId,
                        brandStatus: $this->brandStatus,
                        brandName: $brandName,
                        dedupeKey: $dedupeKey,
                    )->onQueue('notifications');
                }
            }, 'affiliate_professional_id');
    }

    public function failed(\Throwable $e): void
    {
        Log::error('Brand status fan-out job failed', [
            'brand_professional_id' => $this->brandProfessionalId,
            'brand_status' => $this->brandStatus,
            'message' => $e->getMessage(),
        ]);
    }
}

namespace App\Jobs\Notifications;

use App\Models\Core\Professional\Professional;
use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Bus\Dispatchable;
use Illuminate\Queue\InteractsWithQueue;
use Illuminate\Queue\SerializesModels;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

// V2: Fans out brand status change notifications (active/deactivated) to all connected affiliates.
// Each affiliate gets an independent SendBrandStatusNotificationJob so failures isolate and retry.
class FanOutBrandStatusNotificationJob implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Dispatchable, InteractsWithQueue, Queueable, SerializesModels;

    public int $tries = 3;

    public function __construct(
        public readonly string $brandProfessionalId,
        public readonly string $brandStatus, // 'active' | 'deactivated'
    ) {
        $this->onQueue('notifications');
    }

    public function handle(): void
    {
        $brand = Professional::find($this->brandProfessionalId);

        if (! $brand) {
            Log::warning('FanOutBrandStatusNotificationJob: brand not found, skipping fan-out', [
                'brand_professional_id' => $this->brandProfessionalId,
            ]);

            return;
        }

        $yearWeek = now()->format('o-W');
        $brandName = (string) ($brand->display_name ?: $brand->handle ?: 'Brand');
        $statusSlug = $this->brandStatus === 'deactivated' ? 'deactivated' : 'reactivated';
        $dedupeKey = "brand.{$statusSlug}.{$this->brandProfessionalId}.{$yearWeek}";

        // Dispatch a child job per affiliate so each notification retries independently.
        DB::table('brand.brand_partner_links')
            ->where('brand_professional_id', $this->brandProfessionalId)
            ->chunk(500, function ($rows) use ($brandName, $dedupeKey) {
                foreach ($rows as $row) {
                    SendBrandStatusNotificationJob::dispatch(
                        affiliateId: $row->affiliate_professional_id,
                        brandProfessionalId: $this->brandProfessionalId,
                        brandStatus: $this->brandStatus,
                        brandName: $brandName,
                        dedupeKey: $dedupeKey,
                    )->onQueue('notifications');
                }
            });
    }

    public function failed(\Throwable $e): void
    {
        Log::error('Brand status fan-out job failed', [
            'brand_professional_id' => $this->brandProfessionalId,
            'brand_status' => $this->brandStatus,
            'message' => $e->getMessage(),
        ]);
    }
}

## Plain English

Before this fix, when a brand changed status (active/deactivated), a single background job looped through every connected affiliate and sent notifications one by one. If anything went wrong partway through — a brief database blip, a network hiccup — every affiliate after that point in the loop silently got nothing, and the job had no way to try again. Now the parent job just hands out individual tasks, one per affiliate, each of which can retry up to 3 times on its own. A bad notification for one affiliate has zero impact on everyone else.

## Technical Summary

**Files changed:**
- `app/Jobs/Notifications/FanOutBrandStatusNotificationJob.php` — Refactored `handle()` to chunk-query `brand.brand_partner_links` and dispatch one `SendBrandStatusNotificationJob` per affiliate. Removed direct `NotificationPublisher` dependency. Bumped `$tries` from 1 → 3. Added `->orderBy('id')` required by `chunk()`.
- `app/Jobs/Notifications/SendBrandStatusNotificationJob.php` *(new)* — Per-affiliate child job. Accepts `affiliateId`, `brandProfessionalId`, `brandStatus`, `brandName`, `dedupeKey`. Calls `NotificationPublisher::publish()`. `$tries = 3`, `$backoff = 30` seconds.
- `tests/Unit/Jobs/FanOutBrandStatusNotificationGuardTest.php` — Updated tests from asserting `publisher->publish()` calls to asserting `Queue::assertPushed(SendBrandStatusNotificationJob::class)` / `Queue::assertNothingPushed()`.

**New behavior:** Fan-out parent enqueues N child jobs and returns. Each child retries independently on failure. The `dedupeKey` is computed once in the parent and passed to children, ensuring consistency across a single fan-out cohort even at week boundaries.

## Decisions Made

- Used `chunk(500)` (offset-based) rather than `chunkById` because `affiliate_professional_id` is a foreign key (not unique per row), making it unsafe as a cursor column.
- `dedupeKey` is computed in the parent and passed to children (rather than recomputed in each child) to guarantee all notifications for one status-change event share the same dedupe key.
